library(rdflib)
library(dplyr)

rdf_file_path <- "path_to_your_rdf_file.rdf"
rdf_graph <- rdf_parse(rdf_file_path)

rdf_data <- rdf_graph %>%
  rdf_subjects() %>%
  rdf_ppredicate() %>%
  rdf_object() %>%
  bind_cols()

  rdf_data$vict_age <- as.numeric(rdf_data$vict_age)
rdf_data$date_rptd <- as.Date(rdf_data$date_rptd)

descriptive_stats <- summary(rdf_data$vict_age)

rdf_data$year <- format(rdf_data$date_rptd, "%Y")
crimes_per_year <- table(rdf_data$year)

victim_age_2020 <- rdf_data$vict_age[rdf_data$year == 2020]
victim_age_2023 <- rdf_data$vict_age[rdf_data$year == 2023]

t_test_result <- t.test(victim_age_2020, victim_age_2023, na.rm = TRUE)

# Display results
descriptive_stats
crimes_per_year
t_test_result

print(descriptive_stats)

print(crimes_per_year)

print(t_test_result)
